$comment: A profile is what one generated allowlist contains: gh-aw ecosystem keys, gh-aw engine-defaults keys, and which overlay statuses to include. Each profile is rendered into generated/<profile>/.

base.description: Certificates, Ubuntu mirrors, GitHub, and the Claude / Codex engine endpoints. The floor every other profile builds on.

node.description: base + npm / yarn / pnpm / bun and the Node CDNs.

python.description: base + PyPI, conda, and the native build toolchains.

swift.description: base + Swift Package Index and Apple developer hosts.

workstation.description: Everything this author's projects need: base + node + python + swift + containers + dev-tools, plus every active and candidate overlay domain.
